skill.summary: Create concise 60-90 second videos for career coaches showcasing their unique job search methods, client successes, and practical interview coaching tips.

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of Career Coach Video skill.
- Helps career coaches create short, targeted client acquisition and methodology videos.
- Guides coaches through video type selection, gathers relevant coaching details, and produces 60-90 second scripts with scene recommendations.
- Suggests b-roll and video prompts focusing on engaging, outcome-driven storytelling rather than generic motivational content.
